column5: enables pure data transformations on the metadata layer.

rationale: Correctly models the 'Submission' object by separating metadata properties from large content payloads.
Massively improves database performance and migration speed by keeping large files on disk.
Allows for declarative queries on submission metadata while leveraging standard file systems for storage.
Makes it easy to manually inspect or modify downloaded files during prototyping.
Ensures the project remains lightweight (DEC-001) while providing structured search and lookup.
A robust compromise: provides the benefits of a DB without the 'God-file' bloat of storing all content in SQL.
